consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 120 km/h steady, 0 °C, dry, 20-inch wheels (255/45-20 Nokian R5 EV, winter tyres per sheet), battery-side (car display; sheet does not say explicitly) | Nyland, 'Kia EV6 AWD facelift' (2025-refresh 84 kWh pack, 78.4 kWh measured). Matches our Land AWD 20-inch trim and the 84 kWh pack; Euro car, motor output not checked against the Canadian Land AWD. Cold test, so a mild-weather figure would be lower. 90 km/h, 0 °C: 187 Wh/km. Not used: 'EV6 GT facelift' (different, 21-inch, GT motors): 249 Wh/km at 20 °C.. | NOT FOR CALIBRATION: cold test (0 °C, winter tyres); exclude from the highway-factor fit (item 3.7).
